text: すばしっこく　はしり　まわり　せなかのハリと　するどいツメでの　こうげきが　とくい。

structure.jp: すばしっこく　はしり　まわり
せなかのハリと　するどいツメでの　こうげきが
structure.en: attacks with the spines on its back and sharp claws
are what it is good at.

patterns.name: 〜ます形 (linking)
patterns.explanation: A verb cut off where ます would go means 'and', in a written style, the same as the て form. はしり まわり = 'it runs around, and...'.

patterns.name: 〜での
patterns.span: ツメでの　こうげき
patterns.explanation: で means 'using', and の ties that to the noun that follows. ツメでの こうげき = 'an attack using claws'.

patterns.name: 〜く (adverb)
patterns.explanation: Changing the last い of a describing word to く makes it tell how something is done. すばしっこく = 'nimbly'.
